No existing runbook in `90_runbooks/` names this failure mode; it belongs in one before the next lane touches this same service (P-156, P-157, and any future engine-api change all share this risk).

P-155'S OWN BUG (not this lane's to fix, reported for that lane/owner): the async feasibility job row (`feasibility_export_jobs`) can get stuck reporting `state:'running'` indefinitely after its detached promise's host instance is reclaimed (observed twice this session, both correlated with a Cloud Run traffic/revision change happening mid-authoring) -- CPU-throttling-without-traffic is the mechanism the P-155 code's own comments already named as a risk, now observed live.
